```{r, simulation_parameters, eval = T}
# size of study population
n <- 100

# number of (full) iterations
K <- 10^3

# number of ABC simulations
N <- 10^6

# precision
epsilon <- 0.05

# administrative censoring time
cens_admin <- 3

# recruitment time
time_accr <- 1

# goal for censoring proportion
cens_prop_goal <- 0.3

# use total
total <- TRUE

# threshold for subgroup: X3 > d_subgr_obs
d_subgr_obs <- 0.5 # 0.75

# threshold for subgroup in LASSO
d_ite_lasso <- 0.6

# minimum number of accepted cate_abc_true
d_min_post <- 100 # 100

# proportion factors for "subgroup too small/large"
d_subgr_small <- 0.2
d_subgr_large <- 0.8

# threshold for different subgroup sizes
d_subgr_size <- 10

# minimum CATE in population for subgroup selection
d_cate_pop <- 0.75

# factor for "effect in subgroup not good enough"
M <- 0.7

# True model parameters
## Parameters beta1 and beta2 calculated so that the range of true ITEs in the true subgroup is in [a, b]
beta0_obs_true <- 1
beta2_obs_true <- 1.5
beta3_obs_true <- 0 # nuissance parameter

if (true_model == "strong") {
  a <- 0.3
  b <- 0.7
  beta1_obs_true <- log(b / a^d_subgr_obs) / (1 - d_subgr_obs)
  beta4_obs_true <- log(a / b) / (1 - d_subgr_obs)
} else if (true_model == "moderate") {
  a <- 0.65
  b <- 0.85
  beta1_obs_true <- log(b / a^d_subgr_obs) / (1 - d_subgr_obs)
  beta4_obs_true <- log(a / b) / (1 - d_subgr_obs)
} else if (true_model == "null") {
  a <- "null"
  b <- "null"
  beta1_obs_true <- -0.15
  beta4_obs_true <- 0
}

betas_obs_true <- c(beta0_obs_true, beta1_obs_true, beta2_obs_true, beta3_obs_true, beta4_obs_true)

if (abc_model == "ideal") {
  beta0_abc_prior <- beta0_obs_true
  beta1_abc_prior <- beta1_obs_true
  beta2_abc_prior <- beta2_obs_true
  beta3_abc_prior <- beta3_obs_true
  beta4_abc_prior <- beta4_obs_true
  betas_abc_prior <- c(beta0_abc_prior, beta1_abc_prior, beta2_abc_prior, beta3_abc_prior, beta4_abc_prior)

  # ABC model parameters
  beta0_abc_sd <- 0.25 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta1_abc_sd <- 0.2 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta2_abc_sd <- 0.15 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta3_abc_sd <- 0.15 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta4_abc_sd <- 0.25 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  betas_abc_var <- c(beta0_abc_sd, beta1_abc_sd, beta2_abc_sd, beta3_abc_sd, beta4_abc_sd)

  lower_bound <- -Inf
  upper_bound <- Inf
} else if (abc_model == "linf") {
  # linf model parameters
  beta0_abc_prior <- 1
  beta1_abc_prior <- 0 #-0.2 #0 #0.1 #log(b/a^d_subgr_obs)/(1-d_subgr_obs)
  beta2_abc_prior <- 0.2 # 0.2 #0 #1.5 #0
  beta3_abc_prior <- 0.2 #-0.4 #0 #1.5 #0 nuissance parameter
  beta4_abc_prior <- 0.2 # 0.2 #0 #1.5 #0 #log(a/b)/(1-d_subgr_obs)
  beta5_abc_prior <- -0.2 #-1.5 #0
  beta6_abc_prior <- -0.2 #-1.5 #0
  beta7_abc_prior <- -0.2 #-1.5 #0
  betas_abc_prior <- c(beta0_abc_prior, beta1_abc_prior, beta2_abc_prior, beta3_abc_prior, beta4_abc_prior, beta5_abc_prior, beta6_abc_prior, beta7_abc_prior)

  beta0_abc_sd <- 0.5 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta1_abc_sd <- 0.35 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta2_abc_sd <- 0.25 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta3_abc_sd <- 0.25 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta4_abc_sd <- 0.5 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta5_abc_sd <- 0.3 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta6_abc_sd <- 0.3 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta7_abc_sd <- 0.6 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  betas_abc_var <- c(beta0_abc_sd, beta1_abc_sd, beta2_abc_sd, beta3_abc_sd, beta4_abc_sd, beta5_abc_sd, beta6_abc_sd, beta7_abc_sd)

  lower_bound <- -Inf
  upper_bound <- Inf
} else if (abc_model == "minf") {
  # minf model parameters
  beta0_abc_prior <- 1
  beta1_abc_prior <- 0 #-0.2 #0 #0.1 #log(b/a^d_subgr_obs)/(1-d_subgr_obs)
  beta2_abc_prior <- 0.2 # 0.2 #0 #1.5 #0
  beta3_abc_prior <- 0.2 #-0.4 #0 #1.5 #0 nuissance parameter
  beta4_abc_prior <- 0.2 # 0.2 #0 #1.5 #0 #log(a/b)/(1-d_subgr_obs)
  beta5_abc_prior <- 0 #-1.5 #0
  beta6_abc_prior <- 0 #-1.5 #0
  beta7_abc_prior <- -0.3 #-0.8 #-1.5 #0
  betas_abc_prior <- c(beta0_abc_prior, beta1_abc_prior, beta2_abc_prior, beta3_abc_prior, beta4_abc_prior, beta5_abc_prior, beta6_abc_prior, beta7_abc_prior)

  beta0_abc_sd <- 0.5 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta1_abc_sd <- 0.35 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta2_abc_sd <- 0.25 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta3_abc_sd <- 0.25 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta4_abc_sd <- 0.5 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta5_abc_sd <- 0.3 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta6_abc_sd <- 0.3 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  beta7_abc_sd <- 0.6 # 1 #0.5 # 0.25
  betas_abc_var <- c(beta0_abc_sd, beta1_abc_sd, beta2_abc_sd, beta3_abc_sd, beta4_abc_sd, beta5_abc_sd, beta6_abc_sd, beta7_abc_sd)

  lower_bound <- -Inf
  upper_bound <- Inf
}

alpha <- 1

lambda_event_obs <- \(x1, x2, x3, trt) exp(-(betas_obs_true[1] + betas_obs_true[2] * trt + betas_obs_true[3] * x1 + betas_obs_true[4] * x2 + betas_obs_true[5] * I(x3 > d_subgr_obs) * x3 * trt) / alpha)

if (abc_model == "ideal") {
  lambda_event_abc <- \(x1, x2, x3, trt) exp(-(betas_abc_prior[1] + betas_abc_prior[2] * trt + betas_abc_prior[3] * x1 + betas_abc_prior[4] * x2 + betas_abc_prior[5] * I(x3 > d_subgr_obs) * x3 * trt) / alpha)
} else if (abc_model == "linf" | abc_model == "minf") {
  lambda_event_abc <- \(x1, x2, x3, trt) exp(-(betas_abc_prior[1] + betas_abc_prior[2] * trt + betas_abc_prior[3] * x1 + betas_abc_prior[4] * x2 + betas_abc_prior[5] * I(x3 > d_subgr_obs) * x3 * trt + betas_abc_prior[6] * trt * x1 + betas_abc_prior[7] * trt * x2 + betas_abc_prior[8] * trt * x3) / alpha)
}

event_surv_abc <- \(t, x1, x2, x3, trt) 1 - pweibull(t, shape = alpha, scale = lambda_event_abc(x1, x2, x3, trt))
event_surv_obs <- \(t, x1, x2, x3, trt) 1 - pweibull(t, shape = alpha, scale = lambda_event_obs(x1, x2, x3, trt))

cens_surv <- \(t, lambda_c) 1 - pexp(t, rate = lambda_c)
cens_dens <- \(t, lambda_c) dexp(t, rate = lambda_c)

cov_dens_obs <- \(x1, x2, x3, trt) dnorm(x1) * dnorm(x2) * dunif(x3, 0, 1) * dbinom(trt, 1, 0.5)
cov_dens_abc <- \(x1, x2, x3, trt) dnorm(x1) * dnorm(x2) * dunif(x3, 0, 1) * dbinom(trt, 1, 0.5)

cov_bounds_obs <- list(
  x1 = c(-Inf, Inf),
  x2 = c(-Inf, Inf),
  x3 = c(0, 1),
  trt = list(0, 1)
)
cov_bounds_abc <- list(
  x1 = c(-Inf, Inf),
  x2 = c(-Inf, Inf),
  x3 = c(0, 1),
  trt = list(0, 1)
)

set.seed(764872)
start_cens_rate_obs_time <- Sys.time()
progressr::with_progress({
  cens_rate_obs <- CensRCalc::find_cens_param(cens_prop_goal, event_surv_obs, cov_dens_obs, cov_bounds_obs,
    cens_surv, cens_dens,
    time_admin_cens = cens_admin, time_accrual = time_accr, abs_tol = 1e-4
  )
}) # "simpleError 'length(milestones) > 0L' is not TRUE" is not a real issue here!
rate_opt_true <- cens_rate_obs$parameter
end_cens_rate_obs_time <- Sys.time()
message(str_glue("Time to find optimal censoring rate for obs model: {round(difftime(end_cens_rate_obs_time, start_cens_rate_obs_time, units = 'mins'), 2)} minutes"))

start_cens_rate_abc_time <- Sys.time()
# rate_opt_abc <- rate_opt_true # activate only if obs and ABC model are similar
progressr::with_progress({
  cens_rate_abc <- CensRCalc::find_cens_param(cens_prop_goal, event_surv_abc, cov_dens_abc, cov_bounds_abc,
    cens_surv, cens_dens,
    time_admin_cens = cens_admin, time_accrual = time_accr, abs_tol = 1e-4
  )
})
rate_opt_abc <- cens_rate_abc$parameter
end_cens_rate_abc_time <- Sys.time()
message(str_glue("Time to find optimal censoring rate for abc model: {round(difftime(end_cens_rate_abc_time, start_cens_rate_abc_time, units = 'mins'), 2)} minutes"))
```

```{r, determine_penalty_param, eval = T, echo = T}
cores_determine <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 2)

# ONLY VALID FOR CURRENT OBS MODEL!
res <- pblapply(1:10000, function(i) {
  set.seed(764872 + i) # should this be a different seed than used in sim_obs?

  # Generate covariates
  X1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1) # Normally distributed covariate
  X2 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1) # Normally distributed covariate
  X3 <- runif(n, min = 0, max = 1) # Uniformly distributed covariate

  # Treatment assignment
  trt <- sample(c(rep(1, n / 2), rep(0, n / 2))) # Randomly assign treatment

  # Model parameters
  lambda <- exp(-(betas_obs_true[1] + betas_obs_true[2] * trt + betas_obs_true[3] * X1 + betas_obs_true[4] * X2 + betas_obs_true[5] * I(X3 > d_subgr_obs) * X3 * trt) / alpha)

  # Generate event times and censoring times
  time_event <- rweibull(n, scale = lambda, shape = alpha) # Event times
  time_cens_rand <- rexp(n, rate = rate_opt_true) # Random censoring times
  time_cens_recr <- runif(n, cens_admin - time_accr, cens_admin) # Recruitment censoring times

  # Determine observed times and censoring indicators
  time_cens <- pmin(time_cens_rand, time_cens_recr) # Minimum of random and recruitment censoring times
  time_obs <- pmin(time_event, time_cens) # Observed times are the minimum of event and censoring times
  delta <- ifelse(time_event < time_cens, 1, 0) # Censoring indicator (1 if event, 0 if censored)

  # Create data frame with observed data
  df <- data.frame(id = seq(1, n), time = time_obs, cens = delta, X1 = X1, X2 = X2, X3 = X3, trt = trt)

  # Calculate true overall treatment effect in population
  cate_pop_true <- exp(mean(betas_obs_true[2] + betas_obs_true[5] * df$X3 * I(df$X3 > d_subgr_obs)))

  if (method == "LASSO") {
    formula <- as.formula("Surv(time, cens) ~ .^2") # .^2 # trt + X1 + X2 + X3:trt:I(X3>0.5)  #- X1:X2 - X1:X3 - X2:X3 # remove interaction terms that are not in the data
  } else if (method == "MOB") {
    formula <- as.formula("Surv(time, cens) ~ .-trt")
  }
  id <- df$id
  df <- df %>% select(-id)
  mat <- model.matrix(data = df, object = formula)

  # set.seed(764872)
  fit <- cv.glmnet(mat, Surv(df$time, df$cens), family = "cox", alpha = 1)
  penalty_param_min <- fit$lambda.min
  penalty_param_1se <- fit$lambda.1se

  list(cate_pop_true = cate_pop_true, penalty_param_min = penalty_param_min, penalty_param_1se = penalty_param_1se)
}, cl = cores_determine)

cates_pop <- vapply(res, function(x) x$cate_pop_true, numeric(1))
penalty_params_min <- vapply(res, function(x) x$penalty_param_min, numeric(1))
penalty_params_1se <- vapply(res, function(x) x$penalty_param_1se, numeric(1))

# penalty_param for LASSO regression
penalty_param <- mean(penalty_params_min) # more liberal threshold, i.e. less regularization, more variables selected, more likely to select a subgroup that is different from the overall population
# penalty_param <- mean(penalty_params_1se) # more conservative threshold, i.e. more regularization, less variables selected, more likely to select a subgroup that is not too different from the overall population

# threshold for "populations too different"
d_cates_pop_diff <- 0.2
```

```{r, error_functions ,eval=T, echo=T}
handler <- function(e, sim, subject) {
  message <- conditionMessage(e)
  if (str_detect(message, fixed("converge"))) {
    return(str_glue("{subject} in {sim} did not converge"))
  } else if (str_detect(message, fixed("from glmnet C++ code (error code -"))) {
    return(str_glue("{subject} in {sim} glmnet numerical error"))
  } else if (str_detect(message, fixed("non-missing arguments"))) {
    return(str_glue("{subject} in {sim} no observations"))
  } else if (str_detect(message, fixed("No (non-missing) observations"))) {
    return(str_glue("{subject} in {sim} no observations"))
  } else if (str_detect(message, fixed("probably too many censored observations"))) {
    return(str_glue("{subject} in {sim} too many censored observations"))
  } else {
    stop(e)
  }
}

error_reject <- function(res, error_message) {
  res$rejected <- TRUE
  res$rejection_reason <- error_message
  return(res)
}

error_helper <- function(..., to_call) {
  env <- environment()
  try_capture_stack(quote(to_call(...)), env = env)
}
```

```{r, subgroup_selection_function, eval=T, echo=T}
select_subgr <- function(n, subgr, cate, cate_pop, cate_true, df, betas, d_subgr_small, d_subgr_large, d_cate_pop) {
  minsize <- d_subgr_small * n # min size of the selected subgroup
  maxsize <- d_subgr_large * n # max size of the selected subgroup

  if ((nrow(subgr) < minsize) || (nrow(subgr) > maxsize) || (cate >= 1) || (cate > M * cate_pop) || (cate > d_cate_pop)) {
    if (cate_pop < d_cate_pop) {
      subgr <- df
      cate <- cate_pop
      cate_true <- exp(mean(betas[2] + betas[5] * subgr$X3 * I(subgr$X3 > d_subgr_obs)))
    } else {
      subgr <- data.frame()
      cate <- NA
      cate_true <- NA
    }
  }

  return(list(subgr = subgr, cate = cate, cate_true = cate_true))
}
```

```{r, obs_simulation, eval=T, echo=T}
sim_obs <- function(i, n, betas_obs_true, cens_admin, time_accr, penalty_param, d_subgr_small, d_subgr_large, d_cate_pop, rate = rate_opt_true, method = c("LASSO", "MOB", "Cox"), model = c("marginal", "dependent", "full main")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  model <- match.arg(model)
  options(warn = 2)
  set.seed(764872 + i)
  res <- data.frame(i = i)
  res$rejected <- FALSE
  res$rejection_reason <- NA

  # Create data frame with observed data
  # Generate covariates
  X1 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1) # Normally distributed covariate
  X2 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1) # Normally distributed covariate
  X3 <- runif(n, min = 0, max = 1) # Uniformly distributed covariate

  # Treatment assignment
  trt <- sample(c(rep(1, n / 2), rep(0, n / 2))) # Randomly assign treatment

  # Model parameters
  lambda_obs <- exp(-(betas_obs_true[1] + betas_obs_true[2] * trt + betas_obs_true[3] * X1 + betas_obs_true[4] * X2 + betas_obs_true[5] * I(X3 > d_subgr_obs) * X3 * trt) / alpha)

  # Generate event times and censoring times
  time_event <- rweibull(n, scale = lambda_obs, shape = alpha) # Event times
  time_cens_rand <- rexp(n, rate = rate) # Random censoring times
  time_cens_recr <- runif(n, cens_admin - time_accr, cens_admin) # Recruitment censoring times

  # Determine observed times and censoring indicators
  time_cens <- pmin(time_cens_rand, time_cens_recr) # Minimum of random and recruitment censoring times
  time_obs <- pmin(time_event, time_cens) # Observed times are the minimum of event and censoring times
  delta <- ifelse(time_event < time_cens, 1, 0) # Censoring indicator (1 if event, 0 if censored)

  # Create data frame with observed data
  df_obs <- data.frame(id = seq(1, n), time = time_obs, cens = delta, X1 = X1, X2 = X2, X3 = X3, trt = trt)

  # Calculate true overall treatment effect in population
  res$cate_pop_true <- exp(mean(betas_obs_true[2] + betas_obs_true[5] * df_obs$X3 * I(df_obs$X3 > d_subgr_obs)))

  # Calculate censoring proportion in each simulated dataset
  res$cens_prop_true <- nrow(df_obs[df_obs$cens == 0, ]) / n

  # Calculate true individual treatment effect (ITE)
  # Could be used do define the true subgroup or compare ITE in true and observed subgroup
  ite_true <- exp(betas_obs_true[2] + betas_obs_true[5] * df_obs$X3 * I(df_obs$X3 > d_subgr_obs))

  # Define true subgroup
  subgr_true <- df_obs[df_obs$X3 > d_subgr_obs, ] # Subgroup where X3 > d_subgr_obs

  # Calculate conditional average treatment effect (CATE) in the true subgroup
  if (nrow(subgr_true) == 0) {
    subgr_true <- df_obs
    res$cate_true <- res$cate_pop_true
  } else {
    res$cate_true <- exp(mean(betas_obs_true[2] + betas_obs_true[5] * subgr_true$X3 * I(subgr_true$X3 > d_subgr_obs)))
  }

  # Estimate trt effect in observed study population using marginal model
  fit_pop_obs <- tryCatch(
    coxph(data = df_obs, formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ trt, y = FALSE),
    error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox")
  )
  if (is.character(fit_pop_obs)) {
    return(error_reject(res, fit_pop_obs))
  }

  res$cate_pop_obs <- exp(coef(fit_pop_obs)["trt"])

  # subgroup identification method on obs dataset
  if (method == "LASSO") {
    # Use LASSO on observed dataset
    result_obs <- tryCatch(
      ident_subgr_lasso(df_obs, d_ite = d_ite_lasso, penalty_param = penalty_param),
      error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-LASSO")
    )
    if (is.character(result_obs)) {
      return(error_reject(res, result_obs))
    }

    subgr_obs <- result_obs$subgr
    res$pred_correct_obs <- result_obs$pred_correct
    nonzero_coefs_obs <- result_obs$nonzero_coefs
    coefs_obs <- result_obs$coefs

    coefs_obs_vec <- as.vector(coefs_obs)
    names(coefs_obs_vec) <- paste0(rownames(coefs_obs), "_obs")
    coefs_obs_df <- as.data.frame(t(coefs_obs_vec))
    res <- cbind(res, coefs_obs_df)

    res$penalty_param <- result_obs$penalty_param

    # Calculate conditional average treatment effect (CATE) in the observed subgroup
    if (nrow(subgr_obs) > 1) {
      if (model == "full main") {
        fit_obs <- tryCatch(
          coxph(data = subgr_obs, formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ trt + X1 + X2 + X3, y = FALSE), #
          error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-LASSO CATE")
        )
        if (is.character(fit_obs)) {
          return(error_reject(res, fit_obs))
        }
        res$cate_obs <- exp(coef(fit_obs)["trt"])
      } else if (model == "dependent") {
        fit_obs <- tryCatch(
          exp(mean(log(subgr_obs$ite))),
          error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-MOB CATE")
        )
        if (is.character(fit_obs)) {
          return(error_reject(res, fit_obs))
        }
        res$cate_obs <- fit_obs
      } else if (model == "marginal") {
        fit_obs <- tryCatch(
          coxph(data = subgr_obs, formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ trt, y = FALSE),
          error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-LASSO CATE")
        )
        if (is.character(fit_obs)) {
          return(error_reject(res, fit_obs))
        }
        res$cate_obs <- exp(coef(fit_obs)["trt"])
      }
      res$cate_obs_true <- exp(mean(betas_obs_true[2] + betas_obs_true[5] * subgr_obs$X3 * I(subgr_obs$X3 > d_subgr_obs)))
    } else {
      res$cate_obs <- NA
      res$cate_obs_true <- NA
    }
  } else if (method == "MOB") {
    result_obs <- tryCatch(
      ident_subgr_mob(df_obs),
      error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-MOB")
    )
    if (is.character(result_obs)) {
      return(error_reject(res, result_obs))
    }

    subgr_obs_list <- result_obs$subgr_list

    coefs_obs_df_list <- lapply(result_obs$coefs_list, function(coefs) {
      coefs_vec <- as.vector(coefs[[1]])
      names(coefs_vec) <- paste0(names(coefs[[1]]), "_obs")
      df_coefs <- as.data.frame(t(coefs_vec))
      df_coefs$node <- coefs[[2]]
      return(df_coefs)
    })

    coefs <- bind_rows(coefs_obs_df_list)

    subgr_cate_obs_list <- lapply(subgr_obs_list, function(subgr) {
      if (model == "full main") {
        fit_obs <- tryCatch(
          coxph(data = subgr[[1]], formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ trt + X1 + X2 + X3, y = FALSE),
          error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-MOB CATE")
        )
        if (is.character(fit_obs)) {
          return(error_reject(res, fit_obs))
        }
        cate_obs <- exp(coef(fit_obs))["trt"]
      } else if (model == "dependent") {
        fit_obs <- tryCatch(
          exp(coefs[coefs$node == subgr[[2]], "trt_obs"]),
          error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-MOB CATE")
        )
        if (is.character(fit_obs)) {

        }

      } else if (model == "marginal") {
        fit_obs <- tryCatch(

          error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-MOB CATE")
        )

          return(error_reject(res, fit_obs))
        }
        cate_obs <- exp(coef(fit_obs))["trt"]
      }
      return(list(subgr = subgr[[1]], cate = cate_obs, node = subgr[[2]]))
    })

    cates_obs <- sapply(subgr_cate_obs_list, "[", 2)
    selected <- subgr_cate_obs_list[[which.min(cates_obs)]]

    subgr_obs <- selected$subgr
    res$cate_obs <- selected$cate
    node_subgr_obs <- selected$node

    filter <- sapply(coefs_obs_df_list, function(df) {
      if (df$node == node_subgr_obs) {
        TRUE
      } else {
        FALSE
      }
    })
    coefs_obs <- coefs_obs_df_list[filter]

    res <- cbind(res, as.data.frame(coefs_obs))

    res$cate_obs_true <- exp(mean(betas_obs_true[2] + betas_obs_true[5] * subgr_obs$X3 * I(subgr_obs$X3 > d_subgr_obs)))
    res$pred_correct_obs <- result_obs$pred_correct
    res$penalty_param <- result_obs$penalty_param
    nonzero_coefs_obs <- result_obs$nonzero_coefs
  } else if (method == "Cox") {
    result_obs <- tryCatch(

      error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-LASSO")

      return(error_reject(res, result_obs))
    }

    res$pred_correct_obs <- result_obs$pred_correct
    significant_coefs_obs <- result_obs$significant_coefs
    coefs_obs <- result_obs$coefs

    coefs_obs_vec <- as.vector(coefs_obs)
    names(coefs_obs_vec) <- paste0(names(coefs_obs), "_obs")
    coefs_obs_df <- as.data.frame(t(coefs_obs_vec))
    res <- cbind(res, coefs_obs_df)

    # Calculate conditional average treatment effect (CATE) in the observed subgroup
    if (nrow(subgr_obs) > 1) {
      if (model == "full main") {
        fit_obs <- tryCatch(
          coxph(data = subgr_obs, formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ trt + X1 + X2 + X3, y = FALSE), #
          error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-LASSO CATE")
        )
        if (is.character(fit_obs)) {
          return(error_reject(res, fit_obs))
        }
        res$cate_obs <- exp(coef(fit_obs)["trt"])
      } else if (model == "dependent") {
        fit_obs <- tryCatch(
          exp(mean(log(subgr_obs$ite))),
          error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-MOB CATE")
        )
        if (is.character(fit_obs)) {
          return(error_reject(res, fit_obs))
        }
        res$cate_obs <- fit_obs
      } else if (model == "marginal") {
        fit_obs <- tryCatch(
          coxph(data = subgr_obs, formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ trt, y = FALSE),
          error = function(e) handler(e, "obs", "Cox-LASSO CATE")
        )
        if (is.character(fit_obs)) {
          return(error_reject(res, fit_obs))
        }
        res$cate_obs <- exp(coef(fit_obs)["trt"])
      }
      res$cate_obs_true <- exp(mean(betas_obs_true[2] + betas_obs_true[5] * subgr_obs$X3 * I(subgr_obs$X3 > d_subgr_obs)))
    } else {
      res$cate_obs <- NA
      res$cate_obs_true <- NA
    }
  } else {
    stop("Method not supported")
  }

  res$subgr_size_before <- nrow(subgr_obs)

  # Overlap between true and observed subgroup (only when a subgroup is observed! Cases where df_obs is selected as a subgroup are not included, therefore the discrepancy to rejection reason "No observed subgroup")
  res$overlap_obs <- sum(subgr_obs$id %in% subgr_true$id)
  if (nrow(subgr_obs) != 0) {
    # how many patients of the true subgroup are actually selected, i.e. are in the observed subgroup?
    res$sensitivity_obs <- res$overlap_obs / nrow(subgr_true)
  } else {
    res$sensitivity_obs <- NA
  }
  # how many patients of the observed subgroup are correctly selected, i.e. are in the true subgroup?
  res$precision_obs <- res$overlap_obs / nrow(subgr_obs) # no check if nrow(subgr_obs) == 0 needed, because its automatically NaN

  # selection rules for observed subgroup beyond ident_subgrs
  if (!is.na(res$cate_obs)) {
    subgr_cate_obs <- select_subgr(n, subgr_obs, res$cate_obs, res$cate_pop_obs, res$cate_obs_true, df_obs, betas_obs_true, d_subgr_small, d_subgr_large, d_cate_pop)
    subgr_obs <- subgr_cate_obs$subgr
    res$cate_obs <- subgr_cate_obs$cate
    res$cate_obs_true <- subgr_cate_obs$cate_true
  }

  res$subgr_size_after <- nrow(subgr_obs)

  # Overlap between true and observed subgroup (includes cases where df_obs is selected as a subgroup because subgr_obs is defined as such)
  res$overlap_obs_broad <- sum(subgr_obs$id %in% subgr_true$id)
  if (nrow(subgr_obs) != 0) {
    # how many patients of the true subgroup are actually selected, i.e. are in the observed subgroup?
    res$sensitivity_obs_broad <- res$overlap_obs_broad / nrow(subgr_true)
  } else {
    res$sensitivity_obs_broad <- NA
  }
  # how many patients of the observed subgroup are correctly selected, i.e. are in the true subgroup?
  res$precision_obs_broad <- res$overlap_obs_broad / nrow(subgr_obs) # no check if nrow(subgr_obs) == 0 needed, because its automatically NaN

  if (is.na(res$cate_obs)) {
    res$rejected <- TRUE
    res$rejection_reason <- "No observed subgroup"
    return(res)
  }

  return(res)
}
```

```{r, abc_simulation, eval=T, echo=T}
sim_abc <- function(j, n, betas_abc_prior, betas_abc_var, cens_admin, time_accr, cate_pop_true, epsilon, penalty_param, d_subgr_small, d_subgr_large, d_cate_pop, lower_bound = lower_bound, upper_bound = upper_bound, rate = rate_opt_abc, method = c("LASSO", "MOB", "Cox"), model = c("marginal", "dependent", "full main"), abc_model = c("ideal", "linf", "minf")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  model <- match.arg(model)
  abc_model <- match.arg(abc_model)
  options(warn = 2)
  # j <- 9387
  # rate <- rate_opt_abc
  set.seed(7648721 + j)
  res <- data.frame(j = j)
  res$rejected <- FALSE
  res$rejection_reason <- NA

  # Generate true beta coefficients for ABC simulation
  beta0_abc_true <- rnorm(1, mean = betas_abc_prior[1], sd = betas_abc_var[1])
  beta1_abc_true <- rnorm(1, mean = betas_abc_prior[2], sd = betas_abc_var[2])
  beta2_abc_true <- rnorm(1, mean = betas_abc_prior[3], sd = betas_abc_var[3])
  beta3_abc_true <- rnorm(1, mean = betas_abc_prior[4], sd = betas_abc_var[4])
  beta4_abc_true <- rnorm(1, mean = betas_abc_prior[5], sd = betas_abc_var[5])
  res$beta0_abc_true <- beta0_abc_true
  res$beta1_abc_true <- beta1_abc_true
  res$beta2_abc_true <- beta2_abc_true
  res$beta3_abc_true <- beta3_abc_true
  res$beta4_abc_true <- beta4_abc_true

  if (abc_model == "linf" | abc_model == "minf") {
    beta5_abc_true <- rtruncnorm(1, a = lower_bound, b = upper_bound, mean = betas_abc_prior[6], sd = betas_abc_var[6])
    beta6_abc_true <- rtruncnorm(1, a = lower_bound, b = upper_bound, mean = betas_abc_prior[7], sd = betas_abc_var[7])
    beta7_abc_true <- rtruncnorm(1, a = lower_bound, b = upper_bound, mean = betas_abc_prior[8], sd = betas_abc_var[8])
    res$beta5_abc_true <- beta5_abc_true
    res$beta6_abc_true <- beta6_abc_true
    res$beta7_abc_true <- beta7_abc_true
  }

  # Generate covariates
  X1_abc <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  X2_abc <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  X3_abc <- runif(n, min = 0, max = 1)

  # Treatment assignment 50%:50%
  trt_abc <- sample(c(rep(1, n / 2), rep(0, n / 2)))

  if (abc_model == "ideal") {
    lambda_abc <- exp(-(beta0_abc_true + beta1_abc_true * trt_abc + beta2_abc_true * X1_abc + beta3_abc_true * X2_abc + beta4_abc_true * X3_abc * trt_abc * I(X3_abc > d_subgr_obs)) / alpha)
  } else if (abc_model == "linf" | abc_model == "minf") {
    lambda_abc <- exp(-(beta0_abc_true + beta1_abc_true * trt_abc + beta2_abc_true * X1_abc + beta3_abc_true * X2_abc + beta4_abc_true * X3_abc + beta5_abc_true * trt_abc * X1_abc + beta6_abc_true * trt_abc * X2_abc + beta7_abc_true * trt_abc * X3_abc) / alpha)
  }

  # Generate event times and censoring times
  time_event <- rweibull(n, scale = lambda_abc, shape = alpha) # Event times
  time_cens_rand <- rexp(n, rate = rate) # Random censoring times
  time_cens_recr <- runif(n, cens_admin - time_accr, cens_admin) # Recruitment censoring times

  # Determine observed times and censoring indicators
  time_cens <- pmin(time_cens_rand, time_cens_recr) # Minimum of random and recruitment censoring times
  time_obs <- pmin(time_event, time_cens) # Observed times are the minimum of event and censoring times
  delta <- ifelse(time_event < time_cens, 1, 0) # Censoring indicator (1 if event, 0 if censored)

  # Create data frame with observed data
  df_abc <- data.frame(id = seq(1, n), time = time_obs, cens = delta, X1 = X1_abc, X2 = X2_abc, X3 = X3_abc, trt = trt_abc)

  if (abc_model == "ideal") {

    res$cate_pop_abc_true <- exp(mean(beta1_abc_true + beta5_abc_true * df_abc$X1 + beta6_abc_true * df_abc$X2 + beta7_abc_true * df_abc$X3))
  }

          return(error_reject(res, fit_abc))
        }
        res$cate_abc <- fit_abc
      } else if (model == "marginal") {
        fit_abc <- tryCatch(
          coxph(data = subgr_abc, formula = Surv(time, cens) ~ trt, y = FALSE),
          error = function(e) handler(e, "abc", "Cox-LASSO CATE")
        )
        if (is.character(fit_abc)) {
          return(error_reject(res, fit_abc))
        }
        res$cate_abc <- exp(coef(fit_abc)["trt"])
      }
      if (abc_model == "ideal") {
        res$cate_abc_true <- exp(mean(beta1_abc_true + beta4_abc_true * subgr_abc$X3 * I(subgr_abc$X3 > d_subgr_obs)))
      } else if (abc_model == "linf" | abc_model == "minf") {
        res$cate_abc_true <- exp(mean(beta1_abc_true + beta5_abc_true * subgr_abc$X1 + beta6_abc_true * subgr_abc$X2 + beta7_abc_true * subgr_abc$X3))
      }
    } else {
      res$cate_abc <- NA
      res$cate_abc_true <- NA
    }
  } else {
    stop("Method not supported")
  }

  res$subgr_size_abc_before <- nrow(subgr_abc)

  # selection rules for observed subgroup beyond ident_subgrs
  if (!is.na(res$cate_abc)) {
    betas_abc_true <- c(beta0_abc_true, beta1_abc_true, beta2_abc_true, beta3_abc_true, beta4_abc_true) # , beta5_abc_true, beta6_abc_true, beta7_abc_true)
    subgr_cate_abc <- select_subgr(n, subgr_abc, res$cate_abc, res$cate_pop_abc, res$cate_abc_true, df_abc, betas_abc_true, d_subgr_small, d_subgr_large, d_cate_pop)
    subgr_abc <- subgr_cate_abc$subgr
    res$cate_abc <- subgr_cate_abc$cate
    res$cate_abc_true <- subgr_cate_abc$cate_true
  }

  res$subgr_size_abc_after <- nrow(subgr_abc)

  # Overlap between true and observed subgroup
  res$overlap_abc <- sum(subgr_abc$id %in% subgr_abc_true$id)
  if (nrow(subgr_abc) != 0) {
    # how many patients of the true subgroup are actually selected, i.e. are in the observed subgroup?
    res$sensitivity_abc <- res$overlap_abc / nrow(subgr_abc_true)
  } else {
    res$sensitivity_abc <- NA
  }
  # how many patients of the observed subgroup are correctly selected, i.e. are in the true subgroup?
  res$precision_abc <- res$overlap_abc / nrow(subgr_abc) # no check if nrow(subgr_abc) == 0 needed, because its automatically NaN

  return(res)
}
```

```{r, start_simulation, eval=T, echo=T}
cur_libpaths <- .libPaths()
start_sim <- function(K, N, betas_obs_true, betas_abc_prior, betas_abc_var, rate_opt_true, rate_opt_abc, cens_admin, time_accr, epsilon, penalty_param, d_subgr_small, d_subgr_large, d_cate_pop, total, method, model, cores = max(1, detectCores() - 2), seed = 764872) {
  print("START_SIM")
  RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")
  set.seed(seed)

  # Avoid tiny run-to-run numeric drift from threaded BLAS/OpenMP in workers.
  Sys.setenv(
    OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
    OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
    MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
    BLIS_NUM_THREADS = "1"
  )

  # Set up parallel processing
  if (cores > 1) {
    cl <- makeCluster(cores, outfile = "")
    on.exit(stopCluster(cl))
    clusterExport(cl, "cur_libpaths")
    clusterEvalQ(cl, {renv:::renv_libpaths_set(cur_libpaths)})
    clusterExport(cl, c("sim_abc", "sim_obs", "ident_subgr_mob", "ident_subgr_lasso", "ident_subgr_cox", "handler", "error_reject", "select_subgr", "reg_formula", "error_helper", "load_libraries", "d_subgr_obs", "d_cates_pop_diff", "d_subgr_small", "d_subgr_large", "d_cate_pop", "d_ite_lasso", "M", "a", "b", "alpha", "lower_bound", "upper_bound"))
    clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      Sys.setenv(
        OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
        OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
        MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
        BLIS_NUM_THREADS = "1"
      )
      RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")
      load_libraries()
    })
    clusterSetRNGStream(cl, iseed = seed)
  } else {
    cl <- NULL
  }

  results_obs <- pblapply(
    1:K,
    error_helper,
    n = n,
    betas_obs_true = betas_obs_true,
    rate = rate_opt_true,
    cens_admin = cens_admin,
    time_accr = time_accr,
    penalty_param = penalty_param,
    d_subgr_small = d_subgr_small,
    d_subgr_large = d_subgr_large,
    d_cate_pop = d_cate_pop,
    method = method,
    model = model,
    to_call = sim_obs,
    cl = cl
  )

  results_abc <- pblapply(
    1:N,
    error_helper,
    n = n,
    betas_abc_prior = betas_abc_prior,
    betas_abc_var = betas_abc_var,
    rate = rate_opt_abc,
    cens_admin = cens_admin,
    time_accr = time_accr,
    epsilon = epsilon,
    penalty_param = penalty_param,
    d_subgr_small = d_subgr_small,
    d_subgr_large = d_subgr_large,
    d_cate_pop = d_cate_pop,
    lower_bound = lower_bound,
    upper_bound = upper_bound,
    method = method,
    model = model,
    abc_model = abc_model,
    to_call = sim_abc,
    cl = cl
  )

  return(list(results_obs = results_obs, results_abc = results_abc))
}
```

```{r, results, eval=T, echo=T}
start_simulation_time <- Sys.time()
results <- start_sim(K, N, betas_obs_true, betas_abc_prior, betas_abc_var, rate_opt_true, rate_opt_abc, cens_admin, time_accr, epsilon, penalty_param, d_subgr_small, d_subgr_large, d_cate_pop, total, method = method, model = model)
end_simulation_time <- Sys.time()
message(str_glue("Time for simulations: {round(difftime(end_simulation_time, start_simulation_time, units = 'mins'), 2)} minutes"))

check_for_errors <- function(results) {
  conditions <- sapply(results, \(x) "condition" %in% class(x))
  if (any(conditions)) {
    error_messages <- sapply(results[conditions], as.character)
    indices <- which(conditions)
    error_frame <- data.frame(
      sim = indices,
      error_message = error_messages
    ) %>%
      group_by(error_message) %>%
      summarise(sims = paste0(" ", sim, collapse = ", "))
    for (i in 1:nrow(error_frame)) {
      message <- error_frame[i, ]
      message(str_glue("{i}. Error in {length(message$sims)} simulations ({message$sims}): {message$error_message}"))
    }
    flush.console()
    Sys.sleep(1)
    stop("Errors in simulations!")
  }
}

check_for_errors(results$results_obs)
check_for_errors(results$results_abc)

start_bind_rows_obs_time <- Sys.time()
bind_rows(results$results_obs) %>% write_csv(file.path(outdir, "results_obs.csv"))
end_bind_rows_obs_time <- Sys.time()
message(str_glue("Time for binding and writing obs results: {round(difftime(end_bind_rows_obs_time, start_bind_rows_obs_time, units = 'secs'), 2)} minutes"))

start_bind_rows_abc_time <- Sys.time()

message(str_glue("Time for binding and writing abc results: {round(difftime(end_bind_rows_abc_time, start_bind_rows_abc_time, units = 'mins'), 2)} minutes"))
```

# Check rejection criterions and get posteriors

```{r, posteriors, eval=T, echo=T}
# acceptance criteria for ABC results
accept_criteria <- function(cur_obs, results_abc, d_cates_pop_diff, d_subgr_size, epsilon) {
  abc_accepted <- results_abc[(abs(cur_obs$cate_obs - cate_abc) < epsilon) & (abs(cur_obs$subgr_size_after - subgr_size_abc_after) < d_subgr_size), ] # & (abs(cur_obs$subgr_size_after - subgr_size_abc_after) < d_subgr_size) #& (subgr_size_abc_after < maxsize) & (subgr_size_abc_after < maxsize)
  abc_rejected <- setdiff(results_abc$j, abc_accepted$j)
  both_accepted <- abc_accepted[abs(cate_pop_abc - cur_obs$cate_pop_obs) <= d_cates_pop_diff, j]
  popdiff_rejected <- setdiff(abc_accepted$j, both_accepted)
  return(list(abc_rejected, popdiff_rejected, both_accepted))
}

get_posteriors <- function(path_obs, path_abc, n, d_subgr_obs, d_cates_pop_diff, d_min_post, M, epsilon) {
  require(data.table)
  results_obs <- fread(path_obs, stringsAsFactors = TRUE, select = c("i", "cate_obs", "cate_pop_obs", "subgr_size_after", "rejected", "rejection_reason"))
  total_obs <- nrow(results_obs)
  results_abc <- fread(path_abc, stringsAsFactors = TRUE, select = c("j", "cate_abc", "cate_pop_abc", "subgr_size_abc_after", "rejected", "rejection_reason"))
  total_abc <- nrow(results_abc)

  results_obs_rejected <- results_obs[rejected == TRUE, .(n_iteration = .N, n_total = .N * total_abc, rejection_type = "obs"), by = "rejection_reason"]
  accepted_obs <- total_obs - sum(results_obs_rejected$n_iteration)
  results_abc_rejected <- results_abc[rejected == TRUE, .(n_abcsim = .N, n_total = .N * accepted_obs, rejection_type = "abc"), by = "rejection_reason"]

  results_obs <- results_obs[rejected == FALSE, .(i, cate_obs, cate_pop_obs, subgr_size_after)]
  results_abc <- results_abc[rejected == FALSE, .(j, cate_abc, cate_pop_abc, subgr_size_abc_after)]

  get_accepted_j <- function(rownumber) {
    cur_obs <- results_obs[rownumber, ]
    accept_criteria(cur_obs, results_abc, d_cates_pop_diff, d_subgr_size, epsilon)
  }
  j_comparisons <- pblapply(seq_len(nrow(results_obs)), get_accepted_j)

  abc_rejections <- data.table(
    rejection_reason = "ABC criterion not met", rejection_type = "comp",
    n_iteration = sum(sapply(j_comparisons, \(x)length(x[[1]]) > 0)), n_total = sum(sapply(j_comparisons, \(x) (length(x[[1]]))))
  )

  popdiff_rejections <- data.table(
    rejection_reason = "Populations too different", rejection_type = "comp",
    n_iteration = sum(sapply(j_comparisons, \(x)length(x[[2]]) > 0)), n_total = sum(sapply(j_comparisons, \(x) (length(x[[2]]))))
  )

  rejection_reason_table <- rbindlist(list(abc_rejections, popdiff_rejections, results_obs_rejected, results_abc_rejected), fill = TRUE)

  alljs <- lapply(j_comparisons, \(x) x[[3]])
  lengths <- sapply(alljs, length)
  filterlen <- lengths >= d_min_post
  alljs <- alljs[filterlen]
  return(list(posts = data.table(i = results_obs[filterlen, i], accepted = alljs), rejection_reason_table = rejection_reason_table, hidden_obs = sum(!filterlen)))
}

path_obs <- file.path(outdir, "results_obs.csv")
path_abc <- file.path(outdir, "results_abc.csv")

posts_info <- get_posteriors(path_obs, path_abc, n, d_subgr_obs, d_cates_pop_diff, d_min_post, M, epsilon)

rejection_reason_table <- posts_info$rejection_reason_table
hidden_obs <- posts_info$hidden_obs
posts <- posts_info$posts
```

## Estimate true treatment effect

```{r, estimate_true_treatment_effect, eval=T, echo=T}
estimate_mode <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) {
  if (na.rm == TRUE) {
    x <- na.omit(x)
  }
  if (length(x) >= 2) {
    d <- density(x, na.rm = na.rm)
    mode <- d$x[which.max(d$y)]
  } else if (length(x) == 1) {
    mode <- x
  } else {
    mode <- NA_real_
  }
  return(mode)
}

get_estimates <- function(path_obs, path_abc, posts_ind, method = c("LASSO", "MOB", "Cox")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  i_tokeep <- posts_ind$i
  j_tokeep <- unique(unlist(posts_ind$accepted))

  if (method == "LASSO" || method == "Cox") {
    results_obs <- fread(path_obs, stringsAsFactors = TRUE, select = c("i", "cate_obs_true", "cate_obs", "cate_pop_true", "cate_true", "subgr_size_after", "trt_obs", "X1_obs", "X2_obs", "X3_obs", "X1:X2_obs", "X1:X3_obs", "X2:X3_obs", "X1:trt_obs", "X2:trt_obs", "X3:trt_obs"), index = "i")[i %in% i_tokeep, ] # "X1:X2_obs", "X1:X3_obs", "X2:X3_obs",
  } else if (method == "MOB") {
    results_obs <- fread(path_obs, stringsAsFactors = TRUE, select = c("i", "cate_obs_true", "cate_obs", "cate_pop_true", "cate_true", "subgr_size_after", "trt_obs", "X1_obs", "X2_obs", "X3_obs"), index = "i")[i %in% i_tokeep, ]
  } else {
    stop("Method not supported")
  }
  results_abc <- fread(path_abc, stringsAsFactors = TRUE, select = c("j", "cate_abc_true"), index = "j")[j %in% j_tokeep, ]

  join_and_analyze <- function(js) {
    # print(js)
    joined <- results_abc[js, .(
      post_mean = mean(cate_abc_true, na.rm = TRUE),
      post_median = median(cate_abc_true, na.rm = TRUE),
      post_mode = estimate_mode(cate_abc_true, na.rm = TRUE),
      post_min = min(cate_abc_true, na.rm = TRUE),
      post_max = max(cate_abc_true, na.rm = TRUE), n = .N
    ), nomatch = 0L, on = "j"]

    return(joined)
  }

  ests <- posts_ind[, join_and_analyze(accepted), by = "i"]
  combined <- ests[results_obs, , on = "i"]
  return(combined)
}

estimates <- get_estimates(path_obs, path_abc, posts, method)
write_csv(estimates, file.path(outdir, "estimates.csv"))
```
